sections.text: Theme: Robots/CyborgsItem #1: Researchers have developed the first robotic hand prosthetic with finger-level precise control.[5]Item #2: Engineers have developed a robotic device that can draw blood and even insert catheters into blood vessels automatically.[6]Item #3: Researchers have developed smart contact lenses that can dynamically adjust their focal length to bring any distance into focus.[7]

The return on investment in global health is tremendous, and the biggest bang for the buck comes from vaccines. Vaccines are among the most successful and cost-effective health investments in history.– Seth Berkley M.D., medical epidemiologist, CEO of the GAVI Alliance, and a global advocate on the power of vaccines. He is also the founder and former president and CEO of the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative (IAVI).
